text:
Jonas - AE: FYI, EMEA prospect (FinReg Ltd) is requesting an accelerated signature path for the MSA + DPA. They need answers today on: SLA uptime language, data residency in EU, and whether e-sign is acceptable for their finance team. Can legal/procurement advise?
Priya (Legal): Noted. Quick answers: e-sign usually OK for MSA, but finance sometimes insists on wet signature for order forms > €250k. Send the customer's procurement template + any redlines they've started.
Maya (AM): They already sent a vendor packet and a DPA with art. transfer subclauses. PDF in Drive: https://drive.redwood/example/finreg-vendor-packet (see procurement folder).
Derek (Procurement): We need to confirm tax/VAT handling and whether they require a PO before signature. Also need vendor onboarding form filled (bank details, legal entity). Maya can you confirm who signs on their side?
Maya (AM): Primary signatory is CFO, prefers DocuSign. Procurement contact says they "may" require a PO post-signature. Will confirm by EOD.
Nate - Solutions Eng: Re: SLA — customer wants 99.95% with financial credits at 4 hrs downtime. Our standard hosted SLA is 99.9% with pro-rata credits. For Dedicated we can negotiate 99.95 with premium pricing.
Priya (Legal): We can accept 99.95% only if sales confirms committed capacity + Dedicated offering. Also need to cap credits (standard 6 months ARR cap). I'll prepare a short redline for the SLA clause.
Jonas - AE: If we move to Dedicated for them, they'll also ask about data plane segregation. Can we include "data residency: EU-only by default" in order form?
Priya (Legal): Add a DPA addendum: "Customer data stored and processed in EU regions only unless Customer consents otherwise." I'll draft.
Derek (Procurement): Procurement asked for the vendor legal name exactly as appears on certificate of incorporation. Maya pls attach that.
Maya (AM): Attached in Drive. Also they want escrow language for key models — is that a blocker?
Priya (Legal): Model escrow is not typical; ask them to specify exact ask. Usually we offer SOC/controls + encryption keys KMS integration, not model escrow.
docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope #5487 created by Jonas - AE, recipients: CFO (FinReg Ltd), Redwood Legal (Priya). Status: waiting_for_signature.
Jonas - AE: For speed: I'm going to share a short order form snippet they can e-sign. Putting sample below. Please confirm any required language changes before I send.
Jonas - AE: ```
Order Form (snippet)
Customer: FinReg Ltd (legal name: FINREG LIMITED)
Product: Redwood Dedicated - EU region
Term: 12 months
SLA: 99.95% availability (see SLA Addendum)
Billing: Invoice quarterly, PO accepted; payment terms 30 days net
Data Residency: EU only
```
Priya (Legal): Change request: add "Data Processing Addendum and Annex A apply" line and add limitation: "Financial credits capped at lesser of 6 months' subscription fees or actual damages."
Nate - Solutions Eng: Also add a note about failover/backups: "Backups may be stored in geo-redundant snapshots within EU regions."
Derek (Procurement): If they insist on PO before signature we can route but note: sales needs to accept the PO number on invoice. Some finance teams won't pay without PO.
Maya (AM): Customer just confirmed CFO will e-sign via DocuSign. Procurement contact says PO will be created after signature.
Jonas - AE: Ok, I'll update order form with Priya's language + Nate's backup note and send envelope. Priya, can you send the SLA redline here for quick grab?
Priya (Legal): Sending redline now (short). Key edits: uptime, credits cap, incident escalation timeline (SLA credits only for incidents reported via our portal within 30 days). I'll paste the clause in a minute.
Jonas - AE: Thanks — sending updated envelope in 10. Will tag you on the DocuSign for signature field.
docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope #5487 updated: added SLA addendum and DPA link. Status: waiting_for_signature (CFO).
Derek (Procurement): Once signed, I'll kick off vendor onboarding and send banking form. Heads up: vendor setup lead time ~5 business days.
Maya (AM): I'll update the opportunity with the PO expectation and set close date accordingly.
Priya (Legal): Final note: if they submit any unusual redlines to the MSA (indemnity, IP ownership), escalate immediately. For the current items we can accommodate the SLA + DPA language.
Jonas - AE: Perfect — thanks team. I'll post the signed envelope here when done. :thumbsup:
